release: Download Queue Reliability, Asynchronous Grab & History Consistency
name: Download Queue Reliability, Asynchronous Grab & History Consistency
changes: Opt-in asynchronous manual Grab operations with bounded worker concurrency, stable client request IDs, status polling and no automatic duplicate submission after timeouts.
Expose authoritative result states: newly accepted pending SAB handoff, already queued target, reservation only, suppressed release or failed request.
Preserve in-flight Grab state across UI timeouts and tab navigation; after process restarts, require review of Downloads before resubmission.
Keep background release validation and existing cross-runtime reservation rules; protect indexer credentials and NZB contents from progress reports.
Align durable Completed history counts/pages with Smart Import and post-processing state; unfinished items remain protected and visible under Post-processing.
Use canonical three-component v3.7.32 release identity while preserving established source and Windows publishing guards.
regression_guards: Source behavioral tests for async Grab idempotency, target coalescing, failures, rejection, and bounded concurrency.
Completed-history scope tests ensure pending post-processing never appears as a clearable Completed item.
New API progress GET route and asynchronous POST status contract, legacy POST preserved.
Retain v3.7.31 video discovery, v3.7.30 SAB 5.1.3 engine, v3.7.29 metadata, Downloads and browser regressions.
New version-specific full gate only; previous full gates stay out of current CI.
preserved: SABnzbd 5.1.3 and SABCTools 9.6.3 engine, providers, download records, Smart Import and existing user data.
Video discovery, All Posts, Images, Image Sets, Electron/Chromium desktop shell, Windows helpers and updates.
Metadata Server 0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector 1.0.31 unchanged.
